description:
The outer-timeout comment ('5s + 10s + 12s + 10s') omits the two additional 5000ms-default waitForCondition waits at lines 185 (has-session) and 197 (pgrep initialUUID). The true worst-case internal budget is ~42s vs the 45s outer timeout. Harmless in practice (each internal wait throws and aborts the test on its own timeout, and all resolve fast: 3.29s isolated), but the comment's arithmetic understates the sum.

Source: cam/issue-313
Review round: 1
